<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240, initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden figure</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const scene=new THREE.Scene();
scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xfffcf3);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,147,-147,.1,2000);
ref.position.set(0,147,500);
ref.lookAt(0,147,0);

function group(parent,name,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  g.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const figure=group(scene,'character-golden-figure');
const trunk=group(figure,'torso');
const head=group(trunk,'head',1,235,0);
const grain=`
  vec2 p=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
  float screenDot=fract(p.x*.51+p.y*.251);
  float noise=fract(sin(dot(mod(p,256.),vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453);
  gl_FragColor.rgb+=vec3((screenDot-.5)*.072+(noise-.5)*.038);
  gl_FragColor.b+=.044*sin(p.x*2.08+p.y*1.59);
`;
function surface(color,vertexColors=false){
  const m=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,vertexColors,roughness:.93});
  m.onBeforeCompile=s=>{
    s.fragmentShader=s.fragmentShader.replace('#include <dithering_fragment>','#include <dithering_fragment>\n'+grain);
  };
  return m;
}
const painted=surface(0xffffff,true);
const C=c=>new THREE.Color(c);
const {clamp,lerp}=THREE.MathUtils;
function fade(a,b,x){
  const t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);
  return t*t*(3-2*t);
}
function mix(a,b,t){return a.clone().lerp(b,clamp(t,0,1));}
function loft(parent,name,rows,paint){
  const pos=[],colors=[],idx=[];
  const n=64,steps=4,last=(rows.length-1)*steps;
  function value(i,k,t){
    const p=rows[i],q=rows[i+1],a=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],b=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)];
    const h=q[0]-p[0],u=(q[k]-a[k])*h/(q[0]-a[0]),v=(b[k]-p[k])*h/(b[0]-p[0]);
    return (2*t*t*t-3*t*t+1)*p[k]+(t*t*t-2*t*t+t)*u+(-2*t*t*t+3*t*t)*q[k]+(t*t*t-t*t)*v;
  }
  for(let j=0;j<=last;j++){
    const i=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.floor(j/steps)),t=j/steps-i;
    const y=lerp(rows[i][0],rows[i+1][0],t);
    const rx=Math.max(.025,value(i,1,t)),rz=Math.max(.025,value(i,2,t));
    const cx=value(i,3,t),cz=value(i,4,t);
    for(let k=0;k<n;k++){
      const a=k*2*Math.PI/n,x=Math.sin(a),z=Math.cos(a);
      pos.push(cx+rx*x,y,cz+rz*z);
      const c=paint(y,x,z);
      colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(j<last){
        const v=j*n+k,w=j*n+(k+1)%n;
        idx.push(v,w,v+n,w,w+n,v+n);
      }
    }
  }
  for(let k=1;k<n-1;k++)idx.push(0,k,k+1,last*n,last*n+k+1,last*n+k);
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,painted);
  mesh.name=name;parent.add(mesh);
}
const amber=C(0xe79c24),gold=C(0xffc32d),cream=C(0xffdd9e),peach=C(0xffba78);
loft(trunk,'rounded belly, shoulders and crown',[
  [64,3,5,1,0],[69,25,27,1,0],[80,43,43,1,1],
  [98,54,54,0,2],[124,59,60,-1,3],[148,56,58,-2,4],
  [173,48,52,-3,2],[193,44,45,-3,-1],[211,42,37,-3,-2],
  [226,34,31,-3,-1],[240,27,26,-2,1],[249,24,23,0,2],
  [259,21.5,20,1.5,2],[268,17,16,2,1],[274,9,10,2,0],[276,.3,.4,2,0]
],(y,x,z)=>{
  let c=mix(amber,gold,fade(102,216,y));
  const front=fade(-.14,.84,z);
  c=mix(c,cream,front*.97*Math.exp(-Math.pow((y-155)/44,2)));
  c=mix(c,peach,front*.6*Math.exp(-Math.pow((y-186)/15,2)));
  return mix(c,C(0xf0ac28),front*.62*Math.exp(-Math.pow((y-240)/12,2)));
});

const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,32,24);
function oval(parent,name,pos,scale,color){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(sphere,surface(color));
  m.name=name;m.position.set(...pos);m.scale.set(...scale);parent.add(m);return m;
}
function tube(parent,name,coords,radii,color){
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(coords.map(v=>new THREE.Vector3(...v)));
  const geo=new THREE.TubeGeometry(path,24,1,12,false),attr=geo.attributes.position;
  const v=new THREE.Vector3();
  for(let j=0;j<=24;j++){
    const t=j/24,mid=path.getPointAt(t),s=t*(radii.length-1),k=Math.min(Math.floor(s),radii.length-2);
    const r=lerp(radii[k],radii[k+1],s-k);
    for(let i=0;i<=12;i++){
      const ix=j*13+i;
      v.fromBufferAttribute(attr,ix).sub(mid).multiplyScalar(r).add(mid);
      attr.setXYZ(ix,v.x,v.y,v.z);
    }
  }
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,surface(color));m.name=name;parent.add(m);return m;
}
const eyes=[],legs=[],arms=[];
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const label=s<0?'left':'right';
  const eye=group(head,label+' eye',s*13+.8,20,19.2);
  eye.rotation.y=s*.49;
  const lid=oval(eye,'golden eyelid',[0,0,0],[5.2,3.2,2.5],0xe5ad2e);
  const iris=oval(eye,'olive iris',[0,0,1.2],[4.5,5.1,2.6],0x798b35);
  const pupil=oval(eye,'dark pupil',[0,0,2.7],[3.55,4.2,1.9],0x111d0c);
  eyes.push({lid,iris,pupil});

  const leg=group(figure,label+' leg',s*18,83,-1);
  legs.push(leg);
  loft(leg,'leg',[
    [-103,7,9,s*.5,1],[-92,10,12,s*.2,0],[-75,11.5,15,s*.2,0],
    [-50,14.7,19,s*.8,0],[-25,18,23,s*1.8,-1],[-4,21,25,s*2,-1],
    [12,19,22,s*2,-1],[23,2,4,0,0]
  ],y=>mix(C(0xca811e),C(0xeea12c),fade(-87,-8,y)));
  oval(leg,'foot',[s*.5,-103,5],[11,8,18],0xcc8921);

  const arm=group(trunk,label+' arm');
  const hand=group(arm,label+' hand');
  oval(hand,'palm',[0,-6,0],[6.4,9,4.2],0x65502e);
  const digits=[];
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const x=(i-1.5)*2.8,end=-22+Math.abs(i-1.4)*2.2;
    const digit=group(hand,'finger '+(i+1),s*x,-10,1);
    tube(digit,'tapered finger',[[0,0,0],[s*x*.25,-4,.1],[s*x*.6,end+12,1],[s*x*.8,end+10,2]],[2.05,1.85,1.35,.4],0x53482e);
    digits.push(digit);
  }
  tube(hand,'thumb',[[-s*3,-3,1],[-s*6,-7,3],[-s*8,-11,4],[-s*9,-14,4]],[2.7,2.5,1.6,.4],0x655028);
  const rows=30,cols=22,geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  const verts=new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array((rows+1)*cols*3),3);
  const colors=[],idx=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=rows;j++){
    const c=mix(C(0xf8b32a),C(0x86682d),fade(.79,1,j/rows));
    for(let k=0;k<cols;k++){
      colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(j<rows){
        const a=j*cols+k,b=j*cols+(k+1)%cols;
        idx.push(a,b,a+cols,b,b+cols,a+cols);
      }
    }
  }
  geo.setAttribute('position',verts);geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));geo.setIndex(idx);
  const sleeve=new THREE.Mesh(geo,painted);sleeve.name='continuous tapered arm';arm.add(sleeve);
  arms.push({s,hand,digits,geo,verts,rows,cols});
}
const mouth=group(head,'mouth',2.4,9.8,25.7);
const lip=oval(mouth,'lower lip',[0,-1.1,.2],[9.3,1.6,1.65],0xe4a129);
const crease=tube(mouth,'mouth crease',[[-10,.9,-1.65],[-5,-.5,.2],[0,-.85,.8],[5,-.5,.1],[10,.95,-1.8]],[.28,.9,1,.9,.28],0x735221);

const sky=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1600,1400),new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthWrite:false,
  vertexShader:`varying float h;void main(){vec4 w=modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.);h=w.y;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*viewMatrix*w;}`,
  fragmentShader:`varying float h;void main(){
    vec3 c=mix(vec3(.69,.69,.70),vec3(1.,.995,.982),smoothstep(-5.,44.,h));
    c=mix(c,vec3(.91,.925,.985),smoothstep(192.,251.,h));
    c=mix(c,vec3(.90,.89,.86),smoothstep(267.,301.,h));
    gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
    ${grain}
  }`
}));
sky.name='pale studio background';sky.position.set(0,147,-360);scene.add(sky);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffaeb,0xffdfae,1.53));
function light(x,y,z,color,power){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,power);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);scene.add(l);
}
light(-110,215,150,0xfff4cc,1.5);
light(130,80,65,0xffead5,.6);
light(-30,150,-140,0xffe6ad,.88);

const times=[0,800,1530,2330,3130,3930,4670,5470,5540];
// Horizontal placement, height, scale, facing, lean, eyes and stride.
const poses=[
  [-21,0,1,.035,.005,0,0],
  [-51,-10,.946,.46,-.048,1,.045],
  [-26,-6,.982,-.075,.018,1,-.085],
  [-9,-81,1.43,-.08,-.014,1,.025],
  [-19,-27,1.125,-.19,.045,1,-.065],
  [-7,-2,.995,-1.53,.006,1,.07],
  [14,-9,1.02,-1.53,-.015,1,-.18],
  [13,-3,1.008,-1.56,.017,1,.015]
];
// Each arm is posed by its elbow, wrist, finger direction and finger curl.
const left=[
  [-47,157,-1,-61,109,4,-.3,-1,.1,0],
  [-39,163,28,-4,225,54,.77,.65,.1,.55],
  [-46,159,17,-37,190,44,-.37,.95,.22,.18],
  [-48,158,0,-60,108,9,-.82,-.53,.22,.1],
  [-40,163,28,-30,182,62,.03,.44,1,0],
  [-35,170,43,-26,209,83,-.18,.22,1,.05],
  [-35,171,47,-28,205,100,-.18,.3,1,.05],
  [-47,150,4,-52,91,-15,.15,-.83,-.53,.1]
];
const right=[
  [48,155,-1,61,104,4,.29,-1,.1,0],
  [42,181,26,27,220,48,-.44,.91,.13,.68],
  [55,162,10,78,177,25,.94,-.32,.24,.58],
  [45,151,-2,56,95,2,.08,-1,-.1,.3],
  [47,148,0,54,106,5,.42,-1,.16,.08],
  [40,181,47,33,237,67,-.29,.91,-.18,.89],
  [43,176,64,34,209,91,-.32,.82,.31,.79],
  [42,146,0,47,83,-16,.08,-.82,-.56,.18]
];
function sample(track,i,u){
  const a=track[i],b=track[(i+1)%track.length];
  return a.map((v,k)=>lerp(v,b[k],u));
}
const V=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
function moveArm(a,p){
  const shoulder=V(a.s*31,216,-5),elbow=V(...p.slice(0,3)),wrist=V(...p.slice(3,6));
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
    shoulder.clone().add(V(-a.s*6,5,0)),shoulder,
    shoulder.clone().lerp(elbow,.52).add(V(a.s*2,0,0)),elbow,
    elbow.clone().lerp(wrist,.51),wrist
  ]);
  const frame=path.computeFrenetFrames(a.rows,false);
  const radii=[2,10.5,11.7,10.3,8.1,6.6,5.3,3.65];
  for(let j=0;j<=a.rows;j++){
    const t=j/a.rows,pt=path.getPointAt(t),k=t*(radii.length-1),i=Math.min(Math.floor(k),radii.length-2);
    const r=lerp(radii[i],radii[i+1],k-i);
    for(let h=0;h<a.cols;h++){
      const angle=h*2*Math.PI/a.cols;
      const v=pt.clone().addScaledVector(frame.normals[j],r*Math.cos(angle)).addScaledVector(frame.binormals[j],r*Math.sin(angle));
      a.verts.setXYZ(j*a.cols+h,v.x,v.y,v.z);
    }
  }
  a.verts.needsUpdate=true;a.geo.computeVertexNormals();a.geo.computeBoundingSphere();a.geo.computeBoundingBox();
  a.hand.position.copy(wrist);
  const dir=V(...p.slice(6,9)).normalize();
  a.hand.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,-1,0),dir);
  a.digits.forEach((d,i)=>{
    d.rotation.x=-p[9]*(1.13+i*.09);
    d.rotation.z=(i-1.5)*a.s*(1-p[9])*.07;
  });
}
function render(t){
  const phase=((t%5540)+5540)%5540;
  let i=0;
  while(i<7 && phase>=times[i+1])i++;
  const u=fade(times[i],times[i+1],phase);
  const [x,y,size,yaw,lean,open,stride]=sample(poses,i,u);
  figure.position.set(x,y,0);
  figure.scale.setScalar(size);
  figure.rotation.y=yaw;
  trunk.rotation.z=lean;
  for(const e of eyes){
    e.lid.scale.y=lerp(3.2,5.4,open);
    e.iris.scale.y=lerp(.7,5.1,open);
    e.pupil.scale.y=lerp(.35,4.2,open);
    e.pupil.position.z=lerp(.75,2.7,open);
    e.iris.position.z=lerp(.9,1.2,open);
  }
  const mood=sample([[.5],[.9],[1.65],[-1.65],[1.48],[.5],[.5],[.5]],i,u)[0];
  crease.scale.y=mood;
  lip.scale.y=1.1+.35*Math.abs(mood);
  legs[0].rotation.x=stride;legs[1].rotation.x=-stride;
  legs[0].rotation.z=stride*.38;legs[1].rotation.z=stride*.22;
  moveArm(arms[0],sample(left,i,u));moveArm(arms[1],sample(right,i,u));
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[figure],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
